verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own credential-isolation features for agents. Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs like Anthropic and OpenAI without ever seeing your API keys, and MCP Hub gives agents MCP tool access without exposing credentials. Both are least-privilege mechanisms, but the evidence never describes issuing scoped API keys or tokens with restricted permissions to an agent. missing for 10: evidence of issuing scoped or restricted API keys/tokens (including for the Runloop API itself), per-credential permission scoping, credential expiry and revocation, and independent corroboration.
